heading: ஆங்கில மொழிபெயர்ப்பு
lines: They counsel to me to endure my passion
Are they unaware of its real nature,
Or do they posses so strong a heart?
If we do not see our lover,
We, with our heart burdened with intense grief,
Gradually grow weak and become nothing,
Even like a small streak of foam in a flood
